text.text_excerpt: This is a great place for your Americanized version of Chinese food. I've been countless times. I personally always get the general tsos tofu. It's amazing and big enough for two people. I also love the shrimp fried rice and the vegetable fried rice. They are quick and efficient and always kind whenever I come in. Definitely worth a stop if you are craving some quick Chinese. Not mad at it for what it is one bit.

Man, this is some solid Chinese food in the 7th ward. Nothing ultra special about the place itself but it's some damn good food coming outta there. The offerings are typical of your "American-hood" Chinese joint but there's something a little extra about this one. They know how to hook up the chicken, never too dry, and their flavors are nice and well balanced. Lately I've been hooked on their honey chicken combo with shrimp fried rice accompanied with the egg roll all for under $10?! No wonder I had that 6lb swing this week. It doesn't help they're walking distance from me but I think my phase will break for a minute (because I CANNOT keep doing this to myself). If you're in the area and...

Since moving to New Orleans, I've been searching for a solid Chinese take-out spot. I am happy to say that I think I've found it! A couple nights ago, I had a serious hankering for some sesame chicken. I had tried a couple of spots in New Orleans and hadn't been impressed, so I hopped on Yelp to see if there was a new place I should try. I found Hunan Wok's page and the reviews were all so positive that I had to obviously place an order. All the hype from the other reviews were totally on point and Hunan Wok did NOT disappoint.
